_comment: Per-source acquisition mapping (design decision E.D. 2026-07-30): translate a raw ERCOLANO record into an AcquisitionDescriptor, the way the xlsx-import mappings translate spreadsheet rows. Ercolano is a Tier-0 OPAQUE repo (flat metadata, no genesis/interpretation) → source.capabilities = [] and no payload_graph. Add a sibling <repo>.json for each future source; the generic loader (s3dgraphy.acquisition.mapping.apply_mapping) applies any of them. 'descriptor_defaults' are the constants for this source; 'field_map' maps a dotted descriptor path <- a key in the raw record (record value wins when present).
